name: garmin-memory-tiers
profile: 128 KiB watch tier, split into two incoming-sync memory tiers (wide, fr55)

fr55.note: These limits leave about 3 KB of heap free during a sync.

counting.planChars: Sum of String.length() over the entries of planNames, counted on the raw incoming message before any copy.
counting.catalogEntries: Number of entries kept from exercises.
counting.catalogChars: Sum of String.length() over the kept entries of exercises.

request_sync.rule: The value ends with -c128 (the wide 128 KiB watches) or -fr55. Both suffixes stay within 32 characters of [A-Za-z0-9._+-]. No new key is added because released phone parsers reject unknown request_sync keys.

sync_ack.rule: Additive string key present only on an acknowledgement with applied=false that refuses an oversized plan. Released receivers ignore unknown keys.

planOverLimit.check: planNames count or character total exceeds the tier limit; evaluated on the raw message before any copy or replay check.
planOverLimit.watchBehavior: planNames, planWeights, planReps and exercises are replaced by empty values; the pairing fields and language are still applied with the usual validation, replay, revision and ownership checks.

catalogOverLimit.watchBehavior: The leading entries that fit both the entry and the character limit are kept and the sync continues; the acknowledgement is the normal one without a reason.

coldStart.rule: Once, at startup, a plan or catalog stored before the tier limits existed is deleted so every stored copy fits again; the phone resends it through the normal sync.
skippedWhen: an active workout has logged sets

phones.recognition: A phone that sees the plan_too_large reason on an applied=false sync_ack whose correlation fields match exactly stops retrying that sync.

android.rule: Type, syncId, requestId, syncRevision, applied=false and reason equal to plan_too_large must all match exactly.

ios.rule: Binding, ids, revision, accountBinding, deviceBinding, pairingGeneration, applied=false and reason equal to plan_too_large must all match exactly; the reason is at most 32 bytes.

both.planState: The plan stays undelivered; no further retries of the same sync are sent.
both.userMessage: This plan is too large for this watch. Shorten it and sync again.

rules: A refused plan is never partially stored on the watch.
A refused plan still completes pairing.
Queued workouts are never deleted by a plan refusal or by the cold-start purge.
Watches outside the 128 KiB tier never send the reason and keep their existing sync behavior.
